market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.3m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Venezuela production at ~1.095m bpd in March 2026; reaching 1.3m bpd requires ~19% additional growth and consistent waivers. Analysts see infrastructure cap and call rebound 'temporary'. Plausible in a strong recovery scenario but not base case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sanctions policy and Chevron/PDVSA infrastructure investment trajectory.
